result.summary: The page is largely well-composed, but the 'Popular right now' list has a text-layout defect where the restaurant name is cut off mid-character by the rating element, plus a small inconsistency in the favorite (heart) button styling between cards. Carousel edge clipping and the bottom-cut card were treated as intended behavior.

issues.description: In the 'Popular right now' section, the restaurant title 'Tokumaru Ramen' is clipped mid-glyph (renders as 'Tokumaru Rameı') where it collides with the right-aligned rating '4.8 (500+)'. There is no ellipsis or proper truncation, so the name looks visually broken.
issues.suggestion: Give the title a flexible width that shrinks before the rating block (e.g., flex: 1 with min-width: 0) and apply single-line truncation with an ellipsis, or reserve a fixed gap so the name never overlaps the rating.

issues.description: The favorite/heart button is styled inconsistently between cards: on the ramen card it sits directly on the image with no backing shape, while on the pizza card it has a dark circular background. This makes the first icon harder to see and looks unintentional.
issues.suggestion: Apply the same semi-transparent circular backdrop (and consistent size/position) to the heart button on every card for legibility and visual consistency.
